integrity: The theorem is proved from the exact GMRES normal equations and pairwise moment expansions. The packaged checker uses exact rational arithmetic to replay the identities and the concrete witness; finite checks do not replace the universal proof.
scientific_limitations: Sharp classification is only for the second exact-arithmetic unrestarted GMRES iterate on diagonal SPD systems with nonnegative right-hand side. It does not classify later iterates, arbitrary SPD coordinate representations, general Stieltjes matrices, preconditioning, restarting, or finite precision.
title: Condition number two is the sharp second-step positivity frontier for GMRES on diagonal SPD systems
